shortDescription: Manage OpenStack Network RBAC policies in Waldur.

options.name: api_url
options.description: Fully qualified URL to the API.

options.name: interval
options.description: The interval in seconds for polling the async action status.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the OpenStack network RBAC policy. This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: network
options.description: The name or UUID of the parent network for filtering.

options.name: policy_type
options.description: Type of access granted - either shared access or external network access

options.name: state
options.description: Should the resource be present or absent.

options.name: target_tenant
options.description: The name or UUID of the parent target_tenant for filtering.

options.name: tenant
options.description: The name or UUID of the parent tenant for filtering.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The maximum number of seconds to wait for the async action to complete.

options.name: uuid
options.description: The UUID of the OpenStack network RBAC policy. Use this to identify a specific resource for modification or deletion.

options.name: wait
options.description: A boolean value that defines whether to wait for the async action to complete.
